text: The most beloved of deeds to Allāh, the Most High, is the most consistent of it, even if it is little.
The best of you is the one who learns the Qur'an and teaches it.
There are two statements, light on the tongue, heavy on the scale, beloved to the Most Merciful: Subhānallāh wa bi hamdih, Subhānallāh al-Azīm.
None of you (truly) believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.
Whoever treads a path, through which he seeks knowledge, Allah will ease for him, through it, the path to Jannah.
Two blessings which are not utilized by a lot of people: sound health and free time.
Verily, Allāh will not look towards your looks and your wealth. However, he will look towards your hearts and your deeds.
The similitude of the one who remembers his Lord and the one who does not remember his Lord is like that of the living and the dead.
Whoever Allah wants good for, he grants him understanding of the religion.
The dunya (worldly life) is the believer's prison and the disbeliever's paradise.
Whoever follows a path in pursuit of knowledge, Allah makes the path to Paradise easy for him.
Straighten up your rows, verily, straightening the rows is from the proper establishment of Şalāh.
The Hellfire is surrounded by carnal desires and the Jannah is surrounded by things that are disliked.
Make things easy and do not make things difficult. And give glad tidings and do not chase people away.
The Prophet never faulted any food. If he desires it, he eats it. And if he dislikes it, he leaves it.
Whoever witnesses the Janāzah until it is prayed upon, he has a Qīrāț.
Woe to the heels from the fire!
Worship Allah and do not associate anything with Him.
The one whose neighbour is not safe from his harms will not enter Jannah.
A Muslim is not afflicted by fatigue, or illness... except that Allāh expiates his sins due to that.
Woe to the heels from the fire! Wash them properly during ablution.
Does the one who raises his head before the Imām not fear for Allāh to change his head to the head of a donkey?!
The signs of the hypocrite are three: When he speaks, he lies. When he promises, he does not keep it. When trusted, he betrays.
All of my Ummah will enter the Jannah except the one who refuses... Whoever obeys me will enter Jannah.
Whoever repents before the Sun rises from the west, Allāh will accept his repentance.
Spread the Salām (Islāmic greeting) among yourselves to increase love.
The best prayer after the obligatory ones is the night prayer.
Whoever calls to guidance, he will have a reward similar to the rewards of whoever follows him.
When a person dies, his actions stop except for three: a continuous charity, beneficial knowledge, or a righteous child.
The men and women who remember Allāh a lot have taken the lead.
The closest the servant will come to his Lord is when he is in prostration (Sujud).
Trim the moustache and leave the beards; oppose the fire worshippers.
No one humbles himself for Allah except that Allāh raises him.
Charity reduces nothing from wealth.
Verily, the people with the most severe punishment on the day of resurrection are the picture makers.
Whoever reads the last two verses of Sūrah al-Baqarah in a night, they will suffice him.
Cursing a believer is like killing him.
Do not belittle any act of goodness, even if it is to meet your brother with a smiling face.
There is no Muslim servant that prays for his brother in his absence except that an angel says: same to you.
Whenever you hear the call (to prayer), say the like of what the Mu'adhdhin says.
Whenever one of you enters the Masjid, he should offer two units of prayer before he sits.
The similitude of the one who remembers his Lord and the one who does not is like the living and the dead.
Whoever performs ablution properly, his minor sins will leave his body, even from beneath his fingernails.
Whoever fasts Ramadan and follows it with six days of Shawwāl, it is like fasting the whole year.
Whoever asks Allāh for martyrdom sincerely, Allah will place him in the ranks of martyrs, even if he dies on his bed.
Oppression is darkness on the day of resurrection.
The true Muslim is he from whose tongue and hand the Muslims are safe.
The greatest act of piety is for a man to attain his father's love.
There is no permissible envy except for the knowledge of the Qur'an and wealth spent in the cause of Allah.
Do not eat with the left hand because Shayțān eats with the left hand.
Whoever meets Allāh without having ascribed any partners with Him will enter paradise.
Verily, the barrier between a man and disbelief is abandoning the Şalāh.
Every servant will be resurrected upon what he died upon.
Whoever visits a soothsayer and consults him, his Şalāh will not be accepted for forty nights.
Verily, gentleness is not present in an affair except that it beautifies it.
The corpse is followed by three: household, wealth, and deeds. Only deeds remain with him.
True patience is only exercised during the first strike of an affliction.
Maintain ties of kinship if you want expanded sustenance and a long life.
Whoever plants a tree or sows a seed which a bird or man eats from, it serves as charity for him.
O Allāh! Give us in this world that which is good and in the Hereafter that which is good, and save us from the Fire.
